verdict.rationale: Stripe's broader platform offers building blocks for background automation—webhooks that trigger automatic reactions to events (e.g., completed Terminal payments), Smart Disputes that automate evidence collection, and an MCP server letting AI agents call the Stripe API—but none of this is a dedicated 'set up an autonomous background automation' feature specific to Terminal itself; it requires the developer to wire up webhook listeners or agent integrations themselves. Missing for 10: a first-party Terminal-specific automation/workflow engine, evidence of autonomous scheduled/triggered Terminal actions, and independent confirmation that these pieces compose into hands-off background automations.
